card.line: Goshen was a region in Egypt where Jacob's family settled under Joseph's care, and where God spared His people from the flies and the hail.

moments.title: Joseph offers Goshen
moments.text: Joseph tells his brothers to bring their father and settle in the land of Goshen, near him. He says he will provide for them during the five more years of famine.

moments.title: Jacob and Joseph reunite
moments.text: Jacob sends Judah ahead to get directions to Goshen. When the family arrives, Joseph goes to meet his father, embraces him, and weeps.

moments.title: Pharaoh allows Goshen
moments.text: Joseph tells Pharaoh his family is now in Goshen. His brothers ask to settle there, and Pharaoh says they may live in Goshen, in the best part of the land.

moments.title: No flies in Goshen
moments.text: God says He will give special treatment to Goshen, where His people live. No swarms of flies will be found there, so Pharaoh will know the LORD is in the land.

moments.title: No hail in Goshen
moments.text: Hail strikes everything in the fields across Egypt. The only place it does not hail is Goshen, where the Israelites live.
